thread:
mina (PM): Quick sync: enterprise pilot requires audit logs + KMS integration. That’s a hard ask for compliance but adds ~3 weeks of work. We can: 1) defer audit to v1 and ship analytics + UX now, 2) prioritize audit and cut analytics & non-core reporting, or 3) small milestone slip. Need a decision by noon.

tobias (Eng): Can you clarify what "audit logs" means here? Sys-level immutable logs vs simple event streams?

rachel (CS): Acme's security team asked for immutable, queryable audit trails and customer-controlled KMS. They said without it they can’t sign the pilot.

den (SRE): Immutable logs + KMS = infra + legal review + retention policy. Infra ETA: 3w for implementation + 1w for retention & certs.

alice (Product): User signal: a few other pilots care about admin analytics; lowering visibility will annoy them but is not a blocker. Audit/KMS is a blocker for Acme.

tobias (Eng): If we keep audit for MVP, we must cut non-essential reporting: cohort charts, advanced session analytics, and scheduled exports. That saves ~2w. Net impact: still +1w slip.

mina (PM): So real choices: A) Defer audit, keep analytics -> timeline ok, but Acme drops pilot. B) Prioritize audit, cut analytics -> 1 week slip, Acme onboard. C) Slip milestone to keep both -> 3 week slip, keeps feature set intact.

rachel (CS): Acme gave a hard deadline for pilot start at month-end. If we miss it they may push to competitor. They prefer B over C.

den (SRE): Risk note: rushing KMS integration without HSM test increases rotation risk. We'll need an explicit staging sign-off.

tobias (Eng): Technical path if B: implement immutable append-only audit stream (write-only S3 + signed manifests), KMS envelope encryption integration, and a retention policy framework. I'll need 2 engineers for 3 weeks + one part-time on compliance docs.

alice (Product): Ok for exec note we need a short commit: recommend B (prioritize audit, cut analytics) with mitigation for the ops risk. Callouts: +1w slip, JIRA tickets, customer communication plan.

mina (PM): Quick strawpoll: react with :white_check_mark: for B (audit prioritized), :rocket: defer audit: keep analytics, :hourglass: slip milestone to keep both.

tobias (Eng): :white_check_mark:

den (SRE): :white_check_mark:

rachel (CS): :white_check_mark: (Acme required)

alice (Product): :white_check_mark:

release-bot: release-draft created by mina (PM) for branch/audit-prioritized at 1820001187

mina (PM): Decision: B selected. Action items: 1) tobias create cutlist for analytics features to drop (JIRA-3300, JIRA-3301, JIRA-3302), 2) den ownership of KMS infra + staging sign-off (JIRA-3310), 3) rachel draft customer comms and proposed pilot dates, 4) alice prep exec one-pager. Expect milestone board update in 2 hours.

tobias (Eng): I'll spin up the cutlist now and post owners.

rachel (CS): I'll tell Acme about the plan and confirm they can accept +1w contingency if needed.

mina (PM): Thanks team. Closing thread; will post updated milestone card and exec note shortly.
